ai.rubric: Judge whether the research plan has bounded scope, useful subquestions, public-web source strategy, quality criteria, and stop criteria.
Judge whether sources are relevant public webpages, search logs explain selected and rejected URLs, and knowledge gaps are explicit.
Judge whether source_review.json validates subquestion coverage, source quality, search log completeness, rejected candidate rationale, and route decision.
Judge whether evidence maps to sources and findings map to evidence with conflicts and limitations preserved.

Judge whether evidence_review.json validates evidence-to-source and finding-to-evidence mappings, preserves conflicts and limitations, and routes source insufficiency to collect or extraction issues to analyze.

Judge whether report.json is a formal research report with executive summary, methodology, structured tables or decision matrices, substantive product/market analysis, restrained citations through source ids, and no arbitrary HTML/CSS/JS.

Judge whether review.json validates report claim coverage, citation correctness, source/evidence support, unresolved gaps, formal report structure, substantive analysis density, restrained body citations, and route decision.
